identity.display_name: Single-Phase Interleaved Boost PFC Diode Bridge

input_inductance_h.meaning: The existing user input is applied as the per-phase series inductance contribution before the active Boost inductance requirement is reported.

phase_boost_inductance_h.meaning: The active Boost inductance selected for each phase after subtracting the per-phase input inductance contribution.

phase_total_series_inductance_h.meaning: The sum of per-phase input inductance and active Boost inductance used for phase ripple calculation.

public_fields.vin_min: minimum AC RMS input in V_rms
public_fields.vin_max: maximum AC RMS input in V_rms
public_fields.vin_nom: active AC RMS design input in V_rms
public_fields.pout_target: DC output design power in W
public_fields.iout: common DC output current in A
public_fields.inductance_h: per-phase total series inductance in H
public_fields.capacitance_f: common DC-link capacitance requirement in F
public_fields.delta_il: per-phase nominal peak-to-peak inductor ripple in A
public_fields.delta_vo: common DC-link peak-to-peak ripple in V
public_fields.il_peak: per-phase design-point peak current in A
public_fields.il_valley: per-phase design-point valley current in A

metadata_fields.phase_boost_inductance_h: phase-keyed active Boost inductances in H
metadata_fields.phase_total_series_inductance_h: phase-keyed total series inductances in H

public_field_semantics.inductor_current_a: aggregate current of phase 1 and phase 2 Boost inductors
public_field_semantics.switch_current_a: aggregate current of both high-frequency Boost switches
public_field_semantics.diode_current_a: aggregate current of both Boost diodes

metadata_fields.phase_waveforms: complete phase_1 and phase_2 waveform arrays
metadata_fields.phase_currents_a: phase-keyed average and ripple current arrays
metadata_fields.interleaved_ripple_pp_a: phase-shifted aggregate ripple array and extrema
metadata_fields.aggregate_waveform_basis: explicit definition of every public aggregate field

shared_slots.switch: representative per-phase main-switch stress; phase 1 and phase 2 are equal under the ideal-sharing assumption
shared_slots.rectifier: representative per-phase Boost-diode stress; phase 1 and phase 2 are equal under the ideal-sharing assumption

hardware_contract.selection_policy: phase positions are independently auditable; identical candidates may be reused for both phases
